transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. How can I help you today?

Well, doctor, I suppose I’m here because my family and folks around me think I’ve been taking on too much. I don’t see it quite that way, exactly… I just feel like things need doing, and I’m the one with the energy to get them done.

We’re dealing with this move, and I want the new garage built right, not halfway. Then there’s organizing some things at church, and even at work I’ve been trying to show the younger fellows how the job ought to be done. Maybe I’ve been pushing hard, but it feels more like drive than a problem, if that makes sense.
Have there been times recently when you felt unusually energetic, more confident, or unusually irritable, where it felt like your mood was different from your usual self?

Yes… I suppose there have been times like that. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, doctor, but I’ve felt pretty charged up, like I’m seeing clearly what needs to happen and everybody else ought to just get on board with it.

And my confidence has been… well, high, I guess. I’ll be joking around, feeling like I’m ten feet tall, and then if my wife or my boy asks some little question, I can snap at them more than I mean to. I’m not proud of that. It just feels in the moment like they’re slowing me down or getting in the way.
